headline: Proposed rules for plain-language summaries of presentations, acronym use, and a review of Policy BDEB.
summary: The agenda includes a proposed order requiring a plain-language summary for presentation materials, with accessibility standards. It also covers a proposed rule on spelling out acronyms and a review of Policy BDEB.
items: Review of an order from Member Lubold requiring a one-page plain-language summary for presentation materials in agenda packets, meeting accessibility standards
Review of a proposal that communications use the full term before any acronym
Review of Policy BDEB, amended 3.25.26, removing the transparency section and bullets 1 through 4, and referring it back to the Policies Subcommittee and CL-Administrative Reports

CITY OF HOLYOKE
SCHOOL COMMITTEE
Policy & Governance Subcommittee Agenda
DATE: August 26, 2026
TIME: 6:00 pm
LOCATION: Zoom Only
On March 29, 2025 Governor Maura Healey signed into law bodies to H.62, as amended by
S.2506 (which contains the final form of the bill), entitled "An act Relative to Extending Certain
Covid-19 Measures Adopted during the State of Emergency" ("ACT). Of interest to all
governmental public bodies in Massachusetts, the Act extends until June, 2027, the authority
for meetings of multiple-member bodies to be held in an entirely remote or hybrid format. All
public bodies may hold fully remote or hybrid meetings, without the physical presence of a
quorum of the public body, as long as "adequate, alternative means" of public access is also
provided.
Members of the public can access the meeting here:
https://hps-holyoke-ma-us.zoom.us/j/85287777627
Or by phone by calling (301) 715-8592 and then providing Meeting ID Web 852 8777 7627. No
passcode is required.
CALL TO ORDER ~ ROLL CALL ~ PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, s.
20, I am hereby informing all attendees that a video and audio recording is being made of the
meeting.
NEW BUSINESS
Item 1: Review and Discussion of
Order filed b y School Committee Member Lubold that in the interest of transparency, public
understanding, and engagement, all presentations, slide decks and other major presentation
materials included in School Committee Agenda Packets as a pre-read shall, as a matter of
standard practice: 1. Include a brief executive summary (no more than one page or one slide)
written in plain language that explains:
The presentation's main purpose
The key points or findings
Any actions being requested of the committee
Avoid or clearly limit technical jargon, and where specialized or legal terms are necessary,
provide a simple definition, "key terms" section in plain language.
Use clear headings and accessible formatting, including inclusive fonts "Arial, Helvetica,
Verdana, Calibri, or Open Sans" so that readers with disabilities and diverse language needs
can quickly understand what the topic is, why it matters, and what decisions or next steps are
being considered.
Ensure materials, to the greatest extent practicable, conform with Section 508 of the
Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended (29 U.S.C. 794d) and align with Web Content
Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 AA, or any successor standard.
Item 2: Review and Discussion of
That the School Committee Chair and Superintendent ensure that all communication to the
School Committee and public use the full word or term before an acronym can be used.
Rationale: To ensure all parties are clear that they are reading about the same term as
acronyms can stand for different terms
Item 3: Review and Discussion of
Review of Policy BDEB Amended 3.25.26
remove the section that discusses "in the interest of transparency, remove bullet 1,2,3 and 4
and refer back to the Policies Subcommittee and review under CL-Administrative Reports.

Next Meeting
